title: low-profile digital instrument components

specimens.name: Thin ruggedized LCD
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One shallow dark rectangular LCD glass panel in a compact ruggedized off-white bezel, visible gasket and corner mounts, show very shallow depth. Blank off state.

specimens.name: Narrow OLED strip module
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One very narrow elongated blank graphite glass strip with one short integral amber flexible ribbon tail.

specimens.name: Sunlight-readable flat instrument insert
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One compact square matte charcoal anti-glare instrument glass insert, subtle frosted surface and two mechanical edge tabs, shallow metal rim. Blank off state.

specimens.name: Touch digitizer and glass layer stack
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One compact blank corner section of a laminated digitizer and cover glass, three visibly distinct thin clear and dark layers with slightly stepped edges, no loose objects.

specimens.name: Fanless controller front I/O
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One shallow short front I/O panel fragment with recessed dark ports and passive metal heat fins along one edge. No chassis beyond the shallow fragment.

specimens.name: Flat display mounting hinge
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One compact isolated metal mounting hinge bracket with two short leaves, pivot barrel and mounting holes. No screen attached.

specimens.name: Tablet dock contact socket
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One shallow recessed trapezoid cradle socket fragment with a short row of gold spring contacts and guide shoulders. No tablet or full dock.

specimens.name: Flat display backlight guide
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One small pale translucent flat light guide plate corner with a visible polished optical input edge and diffuser layer. Unpowered.

global_forbidden: text, labels, digits, icons, logos or pseudo-writing
extra objects, duplicate specimens or merged cells
whole machines, buildings, room scenes or complete consoles
active displays, illumination, glow, projection or motion FX
E2 bulky CRT, exposed wires and deep rack chassis
E4 robotic autonomy and E5 holographic interfaces

era_contract.character: E3 2015 modular spaceport instrumentation. Shallow sealed glass and molded warm off-white components, graphite surfaces, HD pixel art.
required_signals: Eight isolated examples in the exact 4-by-2 order
LCD bezel, ribbon-tail strip, matte square insert, laminated stack and optical plate must have distinct silhouettes and material cues
replaced_previous_language: Replace E2 deep CRT housings and exposed rack electronics with thin sealed flat glass and compact passive thermal management
Add thin laminated touch layers and dock spring contacts for replaceable instruments
forbidden_regressions: Bulky E2 CRTs, deep rack units, exposed cabling, active screens or illumination
